mapper.sql: id, ebank_number, collection_accounts_bank, collection_accounts_bank_no, ebank_serial_number, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, business_ebank_number, ebank_mapping_id, bank_amount, accounts_receivable, system_code, currency_type, client_name, bank_summary, comment,client_accounts_bank_no
mapper.select:
WITH t1 as ( select t1.id, t1.ebank_number, t1.collection_accounts_bank, t1.collection_accounts_bank_no, t1.ebank_serial_number, t1.create_by, t1.create_time, t1.update_by, t1.update_time, t1.del_flag, t1.client_accounts_bank_no, t1.business_ebank_number, t1.ebank_mapping_id, t1.bank_amount, t1.accounts_receivable, t1.system_code, t1.currency_type FROM eg_non_confirm_collection_sum t1 where t1.del_flag = '0' ), t2 AS ( SELECT t1.ebank_number, SUM(coalesce (ebcrr.claim_amount, 0)) AS claim_amount, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct ebcrr.org_id separator ',') AS org_id, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct ebcrr.org_name separator ',') AS org_name FROM eg_non_confirm_collection_sum t1 LEFT JOIN eg_business_claim_repayment_record ebcrr ON FIND_IN_SET(ebcrr.ebank_serial_number, t1.ebank_serial_number) > 0 AND ebcrr.del_flag = '0' AND ebcrr.process_status IN ('3', '4') WHERE t1.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY t1.ebank_number ) SELECT count(1) FROM t1 LEFT JOIN t2 ON t1.ebank_number = t2.ebank_number WHERE 1=1
and t1.ebank_number like concat('%', #{params.ebankNumber}, '%')
and t1.ebank_serial_number like concat('%', #{params.ebankSerialNumber}, '%')
and t1.collection_accounts_bank_no like concat('%', #{params.collectionAccountsBankNo}, '%')
and coalesce(t1.bank_amount, 0) != coalesce(t2.claim_amount,0)
and coalesce(t1.bank_amount, 0) = coalesce(t2.claim_amount,0)

WITH t1 as ( select t1.id, t1.ebank_number, t1.collection_accounts_bank, t1.collection_accounts_bank_no, t1.ebank_serial_number, t1.create_by, t1.create_time, t1.update_by, t1.update_time, t1.del_flag, t1.client_accounts_bank_no, t1.business_ebank_number, t1.ebank_mapping_id, t1.bank_amount, t1.accounts_receivable, t1.system_code, t1.currency_type FROM eg_non_confirm_collection_sum t1 where t1.del_flag = '0' ), t2 AS ( SELECT t1.ebank_number, SUM(coalesce (ebcrr.claim_amount, 0)) AS claim_amount, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct ebcrr.org_id separator ',') AS org_id, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct ebcrr.org_name separator ',') AS org_name FROM eg_non_confirm_collection_sum t1 LEFT JOIN eg_business_claim_repayment_record ebcrr ON FIND_IN_SET(ebcrr.ebank_serial_number, t1.ebank_serial_number) > 0 AND ebcrr.del_flag = '0' AND ebcrr.process_status IN ('3', '4') WHERE t1.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY t1.ebank_number ) SELECT t1.id, t1.ebank_number, t2.org_id, t1.collection_accounts_bank, t1.collection_accounts_bank_no, t1.ebank_serial_number, t1.create_by, t1.create_time, t1.update_by, t1.update_time, t1.del_flag, t2.org_name, t1.client_accounts_bank_no, t1.business_ebank_number, t1.ebank_mapping_id, t1.bank_amount, t1.accounts_receivable, t1.system_code, t1.currency_type, t2.claim_amount FROM t1 LEFT JOIN t2 ON t1.ebank_number = t2.ebank_number WHERE 1=1
and t1.ebank_number like concat('%', #{params.ebankNumber}, '%')
and t1.ebank_serial_number like concat('%', #{params.ebankSerialNumber}, '%')
and t1.business_ebank_number like concat('%', #{params.businessEbankNumber}, '%')
and t1.collection_accounts_bank_no like concat('%', #{params.collectionAccountsBankNo}, '%')
and coalesce(t1.bank_amount, 0) != coalesce(t2.claim_amount,0)
and coalesce(t1.bank_amount, 0) = coalesce(t2.claim_amount,0)
order by t1.create_time DESC, t1.id DESC limit #{params.pageSize} offset #{offset}

select crr.ebank_serial_number , crr.claim_amount , crr.business_date business_happen_date, sd.bank_amount, crr.contract_code , crr.org_id , crr.org_name from eg_business_claim_repayment_record crr inner join ( select deduct_batch_no ebank_serial_number, csd.collect_amount bank_amount from eg_hy_full_online_bank_batch_no_mapping csd where csd.sum_id = #{params.sumId} and csd.del_flag ='0' ) sd on FIND_IN_SET(crr.ebank_serial_number, sd.ebank_serial_number) > 0 where crr.process_status in ('3', '4') and crr.del_flag = '0' and crr.operation_type in ('MANUAL_CLAIM', 'MANUAL_CANCEL_AMOUNT', 'BUSINESS_AUTO_CLAIM') union all select crr.ebank_serial_number , crr.claim_amount , crr.business_date business_happen_date, sd.bank_amount, crr.contract_code , crr.org_id , crr.org_name from eg_business_claim_repayment_record crr inner join eg_non_confirm_collection_sum sd on sd.id=#{params.sumId} and sd.ebank_serial_number = crr.ebank_serial_number where crr.process_status in ('3', '4') and crr.del_flag = '0' and crr.operation_type in ('MANUAL_CLAIM', 'MANUAL_CANCEL_AMOUNT', 'BUSINESS_AUTO_CLAIM') order by business_happen_date desc
